channel.title: Education and research – HxGN Spotlight
channel.description: Hexagon’s platform for original stories from opinion leaders and customers

item.title: R-Evolution: Blue Carbon Project
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: R-evolution, powered by Hexagon, has joined forces with Beneath The Waves, a leading, global, non-profit organisation dedicated to protecting marine environments, to explore and ultimately scale the potential of seagrass meadows, the world’s biggest nature-based carbon sink.

item.title: Applying a digital twin to earth observation
item.dc:creator: Massimiliano Arcieri
item.description: Digital twin technology, powered by artificial intelligence, provides a simulated “living” replica of Earth to analyse and understand the planet we live on.

item.title: For women in leadership, all roads lead to technology
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: With the recent celebration of International Women’s Day, businesses from across the spectrum of industries are highlighting the exceptional work and priceless contributions of the women who help their companies to grow and thrive.

item.title: Hexagon laser scanners are a “game changer” for forensic investigators
item.dc:creator: Edward Morgan
item.description: Featured in the BBC Documentary “Forensics, the Real CSI,” laser scanners by Leica Geosystems (a part of Hexagon) are used by investigators to capture an accurate 3D image of a location in Dudley, West Midlands, England

item.title: Location Intelligence: Hexagon’s geospatial resources and support for academia
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this final episode of our series about careers and professional development, we'll be focusing on the programmes and resources that Hexagon Geospatial and Hexagon US Federal have in place for the academic community.

item.title: Hexagon’s News Mash-up (March 2021)
item.dc:creator: Brian Tidwell
item.description: In the latest episode of our popular video series, watch how Hexagon technology is redefining industries and communities around the world with innovative solutions.

item.title: Location Intelligence: Landing your first geospatial job
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Mike Lane and Elliott Ferguson from Hexagon Geospatial talk with us about landing your first job in the geospatial industry.

item.title: Location Intelligence: Building your professional network in the geospatial field
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: Networking is a vital component of your professional life from helping you discover job opportunities to finding a mentor. In the latest edition of Location Intelligence, we talk about professional networking opportunities in the geospatial industry, including professional associations, conferences, events, LinkedIn, and more.

item.title: Location Intelligence: How to jump start your geospatial journey
item.dc:creator: Jason Makar
item.description: In this episode, we talk about Hexagon’s role in the geospatial professional community and its relationship with academic programs.

item.title: Hexagon technology in academia and research
item.dc:creator: Clint Mills
item.description: Hear different perspectives from students, professors, and researchers to understand how Hexagon software bridges the gap between industry and education.
